blocks.text: The Thai Meteorological Department (TMD) has warned of heavy to very heavy rain, gusty winds and hail in parts of Thailand through October 7, with flash floods and forest run-off possible in vulnerable areas. In Warning No. 9, issued at 5pm on Monday (October 5), the department forecast unstable weather over upper Thailand from October 5–7, bringing thunderstorms, gusty winds, hail and locally heavy to very heavy rain. The North, the Central region, including Bangkok and its vicinity, the East and the upper South are expected to face the main effects on October 5–6, while rainfall in the Northeast is forecast […]...
